MSI MAG 274QPF E2 27" 2K WQHD 200Hz Rapid IPS Gaming Monitor

Visualize your victory and achieve peak competitive performance with the MSI MAG 274QPF E2 2K WQHD Gaming Monitor. Available at Turbo Computer, this premium 27-inch display hardware is equipped with a blazing-fast 200Hz refresh rate and a 1ms (GtG) Rapid IPS panel to eliminate screen tearing and motion blur completely. It stands as the definitive choice for hardcore gamers, e-sports competitors, and creative professionals across Egypt looking for an advanced hardware modification to step up graphic rendering configurations and high-end visual tracking accuracy.

The MSI MAG 274QPF E2 boasts a stunning resolution of 2560x1440 with VESA DisplayHDR 400 certification, delivering breathtakingly vivid colors and deep contrasts for an immersive multimedia environment. Engineered with a multi-functional USB Type-C port supporting 15W Power Delivery, it enables seamless display connectivity and device charging tracking simultaneously. Complete with an ergonomically adjustable stand (tilt, swivel, pivot, height) and premium eye-care anti-flicker technology, it offers the ultimate stress-free everyday desktop ecosystem.
